observations.role: Maurepas identity and Salvador whole-feature scope assessment
observations.observation: The rounded Maurepas footprint and readable label are separate from Pontchartrain. The entire Salvador-area silhouette is present; its northern lobe is unassigned by the readable southern-basin label. Pages 96 and 98 repeat a map rather than independently corroborating it.

observations.role: Calcasieu name and tidal-estuarine context; Maurepas and Barataria basin context
observations.observation: Printed pages 7, 8 and 10 describe marine/freshwater receiving-basin pathways, varied coastal marsh settings and the tidal lower Calcasieu estuary. The regional planning figure does not establish exact name partitions or present salinity.
